sections.A: Mulligan approach mein therapist ek glide pakar kar rakhta hai aur patient dard wali movement karta hai. Movement dard ke baghair honi chahiye.
sections.B: Ahem techniques: gardan ke liye SNAGs, aur kohni, kandhe aur takhne ke liye MWM.
sections.C: Dosage: aam taur par 6-10 reps, 3 sets, agar PILL response mile. Self-SNAG ghar par.
sections.D: Technique ke dauraan dard ho to glide ki direction, zor ya angle badlein. Phir bhi dard ho to technique chhor dein.
sections.E: Sawaal hal karein. PILL ka matlab hai Pain-free, Instant, Long-lasting.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
